feature.label: ChangeLog Plug-in (Eclipse 4.41 compatible fork)
feature.provider-name: Milankovitch (original authors: Júlio Vilmar Gesser, John C. Landers)
feature.description: Generates GNU-style ChangeLog entries from CVS commit history. This is a fork of the original Eclipse CVS ChangeLog Plug-in, updated to build and run on Eclipse 4.41 and Java 21 or later. Requires the Eclipse CVS Client feature.
